def: to forget; figuratively, to neglect; causatively, to remit, remove

words.word: said he hath made me forget

occurrences.text: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.
words: said he hath made me forget

occurrences.text: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.
Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
